answer: Give every newcomer only a low terrace of privileges, and let it climb only by finishing verified jobs that rotating auditors re-check — a falcon that swoops at random, so no clone knows which job will be inspected. Every job, endorsement and failure is copied to a public mirror ledger anyone can audit, so fake history cannot be invented or hidden. Reaching the upper terraces, where real payments flow, takes many checked jobs over time. A sybil farmer must therefore pay the full cost of real, inspected work for each fake identity, and one failed check pushes the whole cluster back down.
